Name: Kenneth's Valentine's Gift
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Love is in the air in Pelican Town![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Every Spring 14, you'll get a Valentine's gift in the mail. Nothing crazy OP, just some sweet and romantic stuff to celebrate the season.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I made this because Valentine's in Stardew always felt a bit quiet - so now you actually get something to share with your spouse or crush.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What's inside:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]10x Chocolate Cake, 5x Pink Cake, 10x Fairy Rose, 1x Bouquet, 5x Diamond, 3x Sweet Gem Berry, 2x Chests, 3x Warp Totem: Farm, 3x Golden Mystery Box, 1x Stardrop Tea + 10,000g.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All attached to the letter, ready to give to someone special or keep for yourself.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Arrives via mail every Spring 14 - Yearly gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Balanced, not cheaty - just enough to make Valentine's feel special[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- SDV 1.6+ compatible[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - only Content Patcher, no extra dependencies, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- One version, no config, just install[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Happy Valentine's Day![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my yearly mail gift mods are on separate mod pages but they work perfectly together with no conflicts and no overwrites. You can install just one or all of them if you want to experience celebrations throughout the whole year - your choice! Full list:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Christmas Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's New Year's Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Valentine's Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Feast of Winter Star Secret Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Easter Egg Hunt[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Summer Beach Party Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Birthday Treat[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Harvest Gift[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Halloween Trick or Treat[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Anniversary Gift[/b][/size]
